Quiz redesign mocks

Built from the real app components and CSS on a dev-only route, then frozen into these frames. Each frame is live HTML: hover to scroll inside it, or open it full size. The theme toggle switches every frame between Latte and Mocha.

DecisionsTaking a quizResultsViewing a quizEditing a quizQuestion bank

Decisions I need from you

  1. Question dialog on phones. Option A (outline first, then each editor in the same sheet) or option B (Outline / Preview tabs). I'd pick A: it matches the sequential phone flow you chose for the bank.
  2. Editing in the dialog. Today a row opens its editor inside the dialog (shown with placeholders). The alternative is editing straight in the preview, like a Plate note: more natural, but a much bigger change. Keep the current flow?
  3. Bank layout. The grey panel lives in a right column like the dashboard, under the top bar. It could instead sit inside a PanelWithInvertedRadius under the notch. Keep the dashboard-style column?
  4. Learning actions. The mock uses the ⋮ menu on every width so rows stay consistent. Or keep the Check result button on desktop and use the menu only on phones?

Taking a quiz

One page, every question

/quizzes/:id/attempt
  • Back arrow and breadcrumb sit above the title; the title, questions and Submit share one left edge (same padding scale as Settings).
  • Every answer item is a fully rounded bordered row (rounded-input). Selected rows use the accent tint; the letter turns into a filled accent dot.
  • True / False split the full row. Short and open answers are full-width inputs.
  • Submit is a full-width large button with rounded-input radius; an answered count sits above it.
  • On phones the top bar moves above the panel, as on the dashboard. The panel keeps the phone radius (rounded-button).

Matching with the shared Select

Question 6
  • Each item uses the same Select as the workspace Sharing tab, small size. The open list shows the letter and its text.
  • Ordering (question 5 in the first frame): bordered rows, numbers centred, the up/down arrows sit together, and Use this order is gone. The shown order is the answer.

Shared link

/share/quizzes/:id
  • Same page inside PanelWithInvertedRadius. The profile pill becomes Log in and Sign up; search and notifications are hidden for visitors.
  • Clone quiz sits beside the title for people who don't own it.

Results

Finished quiz

after Submit
  • “You scored” with a party popper that pops and throws confetti once on render (reduced motion shows it settled).
  • The score is the headline. Below it, one square per question: green full marks, red wrong or partial (blank answers count as wrong). Grey is reserved for the future Skip button.
  • Quiz icon, the two hint lines and the progress bar are gone.
  • Review rows have no border; their tint hangs into the gutter so the letter lines up with the question text. Marking scheme and worked solution fold into one disclosure per part.

Past attempt

/quizzes/attempts/:id
  • Same layout as the finished screen with more room on top, the attempt date in the meta line, and Redo quiz at the bottom.

Learning

/learning
  • Review mistakes is removed. The table stays on every width.
  • Phones show Quiz, Score and the shared ⋮ menu (Check result, Redo quiz). Wider screens add Workspace and Date.

Learning · action menu

/learning

Viewing a quiz

Quiz preview

/materials/:id
  • Uses the exact components of the quiz page, read-only: no selection, no Submit. The header stays as it is today (approximated here).
  • This is possible because the preview no longer renders through the static Plate renderer; the quiz material view mounts the question list directly.

Quiz block in a note · view mode

note
  • No border and no grey tile behind the icon. View mode shows Start quiz / Study.

Quiz block in a note · edit mode

note
  • Edit mode shows only an outline Edit button.

Editing a quiz

Quiz editor

/quizzes/:id/edit
  • The app sidebar is back. Breadcrumb and back arrow at the top.
  • A compact Details section holds Name (labelled like the workspace settings dialog) and leaves room for future fields.
  • Questions render with the quiz page components. Remove (danger-light, trash icon) and Edit (ghost-hover) sit at each question's bottom right, both rounded-input.
  • Add question, then a large full-width rounded-input Save at the bottom.

Edit question dialog

Edit on question 1
  • Sized to its content (max 920px wide) instead of the old 1100px.
  • Outline rows share one grid: label column ((a), 1.), title, and the type/marks meta on a second line, so the part row lines up with the question row.

New question

Add question
  • A blank question shows placeholders instead of a bare “11.”: the question text, and a disabled answer input showing what learners will get.

Editing a text block

outline → question text
  • How editing works today: selecting a row swaps the dialog to that block's editor. Text is a Plate editor with formula tools, so you type directly. It gets a placeholder that explains $…$ maths.

Editing the answer and marking scheme

outline → (a)
  • Answer type is a labelled Select. Options are inputs with placeholders (Option A, B…); tapping a letter marks it correct.
  • Marking scheme items are inputs, one mark each, with a placeholder asking what earns the mark.

Phone option A · outline first

bottom sheet
  • A bottom sheet (not full screen). The outline comes first; tapping a row swaps to its editor with a back button, and Preview question opens the rendered question.

Phone option A · editor step

bottom sheet

Phone option B · tabs

bottom sheet
  • Same sheet with Outline / Preview tabs at the top; editors still open from the outline.

Question bank

Topics

/bank
  • The app sidebar is back. The right column mirrors the dashboard: the top bar, then one tall grey panel (bg-surface-dark, the existing token the top bar already uses).
  • Exams and topics uses the FilesPanel rhythm: exam as a small label, subject as an expandable row, topics indented with counts, no icons.

Topics · search open

/bank
  • The search icon expands into a full-width field and hides the title.

Topic questions

/bank/:topic
  • Choosing a topic swaps the panel to its question list (back arrow returns to topics). Clicking a question scrolls the page to it.
  • The main area renders every question in the topic with the quiz page components.
  • View mode shows Switch to edit mode (dark, rounded-input) for editors only.
  • On phones the panel collapses into a topic bar above the questions.

Edit mode

/bank/:topic?mode=edit
  • Each question ends with review status, Mark reviewed, Comment and Edit. The button reads Switch to view mode.
